thread:
alex: Quick ping — PR #8619 (accelerator-kernel) is ready for merge but our perf dashboard shows a p95 bump on 4k-seq runs. attaching artifacts and a short summary below.

alex: bench links: https://bench.internal/runs/490123 (csv + flamegraphs), artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/8619/

maya: thanks — can you paste the high-level numbers? p95/p50/throughput?

alex: summary: p50 ~ unchanged, p95 +18ms (from 112ms -> 130ms) on 4096 seq microbench, throughput -2% on 8GPU cluster, mem use steady. full heatmap in the csv.

jon: do we know which kernel changed? my guess is a fallback in the fused-attn path after the allocator tweak.

alex: probable — PR touches kernel select logic and a tiny allocator path. diff snippet: ```diff
- if (use_fused && seq_len <= 2048) {
+ if (use_fused && seq_len <= 4096) {
    call_fused();
 }
```

maya: fwiw that conditional change could push some longseqs into a less optimized path. can we repro with an isolated microbench?

alex: on it. running microbench with batch=1..4 seq=4096 and prefetch toggles. will post short results.

ci-bot: Build passed — artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/runs/490123/artifacts (roles: alex, maya) :white_check_mark:

jon: also include a check with quant-fallback disabled (we saw differences earlier when fallback kicks in).

alex: added that to the run. quick raw results:
- batch=1 seq=4096 prefetch=off: p95=132ms
- batch=1 seq=4096 prefetch=on: p95=118ms
- batch=4 seq=4096 prefetch=on: p95=124ms
- quant-fallback disabled: p95=114ms
links: https://bench.internal/runs/490123/quick-summary

maya: interesting — prefetch seems to recover most of the regress. can we gate the change behind prefetch=true for now or add a safe fallback?

alex: yep plan: add a short circuit to only enable the new path when prefetch is enabled, and add a regression test for 4k sequences. patch ready at https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8619/commits/3f2a

jon: could we get 1 more perf eyeball? @maya you okay to LGTM after the gating change?

maya: i'll take a quick look. main ask: add a unit/regression test and note in the release notes.

alex: added test and release note draft. patch updated.

infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-19T11:30:00Z — monitoring p95 across canary nodes.

alex: canary numbers after gating patch (30m): p95 back to 113ms on canary, throughput within noise (+/-1%), memory flat. full canary dashboard: https://dash.redwood/canary/490123

jon: great, looks safe. thanks for the rapid follow-up.

maya: LGTM. leaving the merge window to you, alex. :thumbsup:

alex: merging in 15min unless anyone objects. thanks all for quick checks.

alex: merged at 2026-03-19T11:45:12Z — will watch telemetry over next 2 hours.

ci-bot: Post-merge smoke CI passed. :rocket:

maya: awesome — thanks for handling the quick revert-and-fix flow.

jon: nice work, alex.

alex: thanks!
